## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Cobram, Australia. It starts at Cactus Country, 4986 Murray Valley Highway.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Visit the border of New South Wales and explore Cactus Country, a garden with various succulents and cacti.
>
> Walk along 8 trails covering about 10 acres. Enjoy Mexican food, take photos, and buy a small cactus to take home.
>
> Try the cactus ice cream while you're there.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €17.80. It was rated 4.9 out of 5 from 4 ratings and 2 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
